study.question: Does the click-orthogonal component of centered auxiliary product-context transfer retain useful click-AUC improvement when tested alone at the same row-space norm, relative to parallel-only, native centered and blocked transfer?
study.hypothesis: In the latest FP64 matched reflection suite, orthogonal reversal reduced AUC from 0.6682972490126902 to 0.6677662770959951 (-0.0005309719166951), whereas parallel reversal yielded 0.6681349871937533 (-0.0001622618189369). This suggests that useful auxiliary transfer may lie largely outside the instantaneous centered click direction, but reflection does not establish component sufficiency. At matched nonzero global Frobenius norm, orthogonal-only transfer is predicted to exceed parallel-only and blocked transfer and retain most of native C benefit. This is a provisional row-space hypothesis; the stronger joint model and the original auxiliary-utility question remain the reference, with no new effectiveness or novelty claim.

study.proposed_difference: Add one nonlearned click_relative_transfer switch. For each training batch, G=(g_cart+g_fav)+g_buy on occupied rows, M is the occupied-row mean, and C=G-M. K is the occupied-row-centered click context cotangent, P=proj_K(C), O=C-P; K=0 implies P=0. Compute both normalized alternatives in all arms with maximum-scaled FP64 normalization. Select ||C||*O/||O||, ||C||*P/||P||, C, or zero; exact-zero directions remain zero. Cast only selected transfer once and add the unchanged click cotangent. The collector identity forward, inference graph, BCE values, private gradients at fixed state, parameters and host training exposure stay fixed. This explicit surrogate VJP is a local discriminating intervention, not a new scalar objective. No external architecture card is adopted.

validation_plan: Local preparation only: compile and AST-parse all four standalone sources, validate study against resolved schema, match CONFIG to variant configuration and constructor defaults, compare inherited method ASTs, check import/ownership surface and source hashes. No torch execution, data access, training or installations in this workspace.

Host preflight on synthetic finite cotangents: mixed occupied/empty rows, all-empty rows, C=0, K=0 with nonzero C, C parallel to K, C orthogonal to K, and small nonzero P/O. Check finite output and correct zero fallback; C=P+O, <P,O>~0, <O,K>~0, occupied means~0. For nonzero selected components check Frobenius norms versus C using FP64 relative/absolute tolerances (1e-9/1e-12); exact-zero exceptions must be counted, not hidden. Test context input dtype float32 and bf16 boundary casts, without requiring orthogonality after quantization.

Host preflight on copied identical model states and permitted synthetic/released batches: exact same four forward probabilities, scalar BCE values, training buffer transitions, labels/task masks and private/scorer/item gradients across arms at fixed state; verify expected changed context cotangent only. Test feature_map label reordering, padded history perturbations, empty-history auxiliary zeros, target action exclusion and arbitrary odd/remainder eval batches. No numerical derivative test against identity forward: backward is intentionally prescribed.

For each permitted preflight/training diagnostic, record ||C||,||P||,||O||, signed <C,K>, near-zero norm ratios (<=1e-10), exact-zero fractions, pre/post-cast transfer norms and changed row-space versus repeated-ID accumulated sparse context norms. Do not claim Adagrad-step norm matching. Helpers _click_relative_components and _norm_matched_projections expose pure operations for host checks without model logging/state. No extra full train/eval pass or unbudgeted diagnostics.

Execute centered_native_replay and context_blocked_replay first when the host permits ordering. Prefer bitwise full prediction parity with g3-r0045-centered_joint_native64 and g3-r0042-product_blocked64; accept only known host deterministic-replay tolerance documented prospectively by the host, never fit a tolerance to these outcomes. If full predictions are unavailable, report weaker metric parity only. Do not interpret new subspace arms on an unexplained replay mismatch.

Then run orthogonal_fullnorm and parallel_fullnorm under the frozen complete protocol. Report full-population click AUC as primary and unweighted Logloss, all four task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean AUC separately, parameter counts, training/wall/allocated GPU time, peak GPU memory, examples, inference throughput and batch p50/p95 latency. Use existing history bins (empty,1-16,17-64,>64) and counts/positives/negatives; other slices only if already authorized and available, with insufficiency explicit.

Pilot decisions use predeclared contrasts and retained-benefit rule. No p-values or seed-robust claim from one run. If permitted later, repeat decisive candidate/native/parallel/blocked comparisons on at least three paired host-authorized seeds and paired user-cluster bootstrap through authorized IDs; do not fabricate IDs unavailable to forward, override frozen seed in CONFIG or regard same-seed bridges as replications. Preserve failed and null trials.

No withheld scoring requested here. Freeze selected suite, nearest successful joint reference, click-only and key attribution controls, sources/configs/checkpoints, seeds and commands before any later authorized closed assessment; its outcomes never enter open research memory for reuse of that holdout.
